# bitbucket_hook (Resource)

A webhook on a Bitbucket Cloud repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_hook" "ci_notify" {
  repository_slug = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  url             = "https://ci.example.com/bitbucket-webhook"
  active          = true
  events          = ["repo:push", "pullrequest:created", "pullrequest:fulfilled"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (List of String) Events that trigger this webhook, e.g. ["repo:push", "pullrequest:created"]. See Bitbucket's webhook event payload docs for the full list.
- `repository_slug` (String) Slug of the repository this webhook is attached to.
- `url` (String) URL Bitbucket sends the webhook payload to.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is active. Defaults to true.
- `description` (String) Description of the webhook.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import/state identifier, formatted as "workspace/repository_slug/uuid".
- `uuid` (String) Bitbucket-assigned UUID of the webhook.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_hook.ci_notify payments-api/{webhook-uuid}
```
